reporting.lead_count_note: Total OPEN opportunities across all three pipelines (Lead Qualification + Sales + Store Material). Contact-level 'lead' records total 7,618 lifetime but most are inactive/historical; open pipeline volume is the decision-grade number.

exclusions._comment: Reconciles the netted metrics back to raw. No contacts or conversations in today's window were excluded - flagged below for visibility.

leads_by_tag._comment: GHL has no tag-count API; hot/warm/cold are exact OPEN counts from the (1) PROJECT: Lead Qualification pipeline stages, which are named identically to the tags. unqualified/stale/lost/rate-shopper/untagged have no matching stage, so these are counts of DISTINCT contacts carrying that tag seen in today's active-conversation window only - a sample, not a census.
leads_by_tag.lead: unqualified: 4 (today's sample: Jitender Singh, Karthic Bremachandran, Jay Webb, Dorcas Kwasi)
leads_by_tag.stale_lead: 7 (today's sample: David Onofre, Pervaiz Ramay, Jay Webb, Jorge Barroilhet, Mohamed Abdusheikh, Lorga Mareemootoo, Ryan Langen)
leads_by_tag.untagged: 12 confirmed untagged-in-queue today; full call-queue backlog size unknown without a tag-search endpoint

leads_by_stage.2. *Project Won*: 297 lifetime wins recorded on this pipeline (terminal status, not an open-stage count)

avg_days_in_stage._comment: Sample-based: New Lead computed from an 11-record sample surfaced by today's call-queue activity; Meeting stage computed from the first 10 of 50 open Meeting-stage records (getCalendarEvents page 1). Not a full population average.

reporting.store_pipeline_note: STORE: Material Pipeline has ~48 open records today (299 total open minus 251 across the two project pipelines) - retail material sales distinct from project work, running its own +3d/+8d auto-follow-up cadence. No stale thresholds defined for it, so no staleness prediction is made.

stale_thresholds_used._comment: Echoed from platform-settings/ghl-workflow.json so a threshold change is visible in the diff.

meeting_window_summary._comment: Based on the 10 Meeting-stage opportunities pulled with calendar data today (of 50 open).
